FiniteRange.statement: A map $X:\Omega\to G$ has finite range if its range $X(\Omega)$ is a finite set.

FiniteRange.fintype.statement: For a map $X:\Omega\to G$ with finite range, the Fintype structure (an explicit finite enumeration) on its range $\mathrm{range}(X)$.

FiniteRange.toFinset.statement: For a map $X:\Omega\to G$ with finite range, its range $\mathrm{range}(X)$ viewed as a finite set (Finset) of $G$.
